setupNotice.title: Finish quick setup to start creating with AI
setupNotice.defaultReason: Pick a text model and the system automatically prepares the task routing for planning, prose, review and repair.

quickSetup.title: Get the AI creation environment running first
quickSetup.description: Configure just one text model and the system prepares the task routing for planning, prose, review and repair automatically.

readError.title: Can't read the model configuration right now
readError.description: After reloading, the system keeps checking whether creation can start.

providerDesc.deepseek: Recommends DeepSeek V4 Flash, balancing long-form Chinese quality with response speed
providerDesc.ollama: Uses a local model, no API key required
providerDesc.openai: Good for general planning, prose and structured tasks
providerDesc.configured: Already configured; you can verify it and set it as the global default directly
providerDesc.default: Once configured it can drive the whole novel production pipeline

footer.startFirstNovel: Start your first novel with one sentence

step1.hintAll: Choose a provider, then enter the connection details.
step1.hintRecommended: Configure one text model to start creating; choose another provider whenever you need to.
step1.viewAllProvidersHint: Choose a provider you already have an account with, then enter the connection details.
step1.addCustomHint: Add a separate provider configuration, suited to proxy services, local gateways or OpenAI-compatible endpoints.

step2.apiKeyNote: The API key is only saved to the local or server key store and is never shown in the result.
step2.customNote: The provider name, API URL and model are saved as a separate configuration and won't overwrite built-in providers.
step2.apiKeyPlaceholderSaved: Leave blank to keep using the saved key
step2.apiKeyPlaceholderLocal: Local endpoints can be left blank
step2.modelPlaceholder: Pick a model above, or type a model name directly
step2.footnote: Once done, this model becomes the initial default for core tasks such as planning, prose, review, repair, replanning and summaries.

customModels.none: The endpoint returned no model list; you can fill it in manually.
customModels.failed: Failed to fetch the model list; you can enter the model name manually.

step3.detecting: Verifying plain text and structured output
step3.detectingHint: Once verification passes, the system prepares every core creation task automatically, with no per-item route setup.
step3.successDesc: {{model}} is ready for the whole novel production pipeline.
step3.failDesc: Please check the API key, URL and model name, then try again.

handoff.title: Start your first novel
handoff.heading: Start from a single sentence of story
handoff.body: Tell the AI what you want to write and it offers directions to choose from; once you pick one it keeps preparing the story, world, characters and first chapter.
